title: Innokin Adept Zlide Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Adept Zlide Kit is the highly durable and versatile vaping solution you've been waiting for. Tailored to satisfy vapers of all levels, this rugged kit doesn't just offer premium durability—it ensures a superior vaping experience. The Adept mod is waterproof, dustproof, and shockproof , making it an ideal choice for those who lead an active lifestyle. At the heart of this robust kit is a powerful 3000mAh battery , complete with a rapid 2A fast-charging system - say farewell to the hassle of frequent recharging. With its intelligent auto-select wattage feature, the kit automatically adjusts to the coil resistance, ensuring optimal performance. You can also manually set your preferred wattage, choosing from a range of 11-14W for coils above 1.0 Ohm and 14-17W for coils below 1.0 Ohm. Comfort is not compromised, as the Adept mod boasts an ergonomic design with a soft-touch rubber finish, fitting effortlessly into your hand. Its advanced chipset identifies the coil resistance to tailor your vaping experience automatically. Now, let's talk about the 2ml Zlide tank, an essential piece of this vaping arsenal. Perfectly suited for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, it generates a modest vapour cloud while maintaining flavour quality. The sliding top-fill mechanism makes refilling a breeze, while the dual adjustable airflow allows you to fine-tune your vape to your exact liking. Compatible with high PG e-liquids of 50% PG or higher or Nic Salts 50/50 e-liquid , the tank comes with two Zenith Coils , offering a choice between 0.48 Ohm and 1.6 Ohm resistances. The Innokin Adept Zlide Kit is more than just a sturdy vaping device; it's a versatile all-in-one kit designed for optimal satisfaction. Experience the best of both worlds: durability and performance, with this top-tier vape kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
